OH MY GOD YOU NEED TO BUY THESE, NOW. If fate led you to this page, and you're reading this comment, just go ahead and click "buy". I regret pondering these for a few days before taking the plunge and purchasing them, I'm ashamed I even questioned these bad boys, because they are everything they promise and then some! They're all I wear now. Some background; I'm 5'6, 140lbs, Growing up I was pretty underweight, fitting into size 0 jeans and even needing to safety pin everything. My weight didn't hit the triple digits until I was in highschool and even then I was still very thin. A birth control I was put on around age 18 caused me to start gaining weight (as well as developing breasts larger than an a negative A cup, and further filling out the booty I've always loved, so that part was a plus for me) But I'm 21 now, and finding myself rather uncomfortable in this curvy body after being stick thin my whole life. Not only do barely any of my old clothes fit anymore, that goes double for my ever-growing legging "collection", but I feel rather uncomfortable even attempting to wear any of the outfits I used to on this new foreign frame of mine. If you are an avid legging wearer you know the stress that comes with finding the perfect pair, and have felt the aftermath of the flukes along the way. Through years of trial and error, experimentation and frustration, I began to ponder the 5 major ingredients needed for this elusive "perfect legging" recipe, and if such a thing was capable of existing and abiding by the law of physics...

1) FABRIC! Color issues aside (...but this black isn't the same black as my blouse!!) you need to make sure they are mostly opaque. If you're like me, you dismiss the whole "you can't wear leggings as pants" stigma. Yes you can! Just make sure you don't find yourself out and about and wondering if the rear is see-through, because more often than not the answer is yes, and if you're REALLY like me that question will be "answered" for you. By a stranger.
2) WAIST BAND! When I wear leggings, I expect them to gently hug and caress every curve, to leave just enough to the imagination while still putting on display every line and detail chiseled into these noble pilasters that support the Colosseum that is my body, constructed by the whim of Vespasian himself to bring not only laughter and tears, but Gods' and man alike to their knees. So yeah, I wanna look good. Nothing puts a damper on that hope quite like a too-tight waist band causing even the flattest tummy to form a muffin top, which aside from looking unappealing, is extremely uncomfortable as well.
Alternatively, a too-loose waist band, or one that stretches out as the day goes on, can end up sliding down your bottom requiring frequent pulling-ups which inevitably give way to a spectacle rarely seen since the dawn of the century; The infamous Whale Tail. ...This should go without explaining. Don't.
3) Length! I don't want to have to cuff my leggings, I also don't want to look like I'm ready for a flood. Surely there's a happy medium?
4) Elasticity! As previously mentioned, leggings are meant to be form fitting, I expect the fabric to cling taught throughout the entire garment. If the material doesn't have enough elasticity you could end up with baggy knees. Too much and you could flex and bust down to your skivs (trust me, I have a few pairs of tried and true leggings I've had to stitch up holes/re-hem over the years, I'm sure you other beautiful ladies with thick thighs can relate to the dreaded crotch blow out or "chub rub", it just comes with the territory)
5) The almost unrealistic expectation that one garment can fit to all these standards. Throw all these factors in and you got yourself some smart slacks! But is it possible? I didn't think so until I came across THESE LEGGINGS RIGHT HERE. Get ready to throw away all your old leggings, or put them on your dog, because congratulations! Your search ends here! I bought the two pack of black, and plan on ordering them in as many colors as they make. When I first opened them, I had a "you-gotta-be-kiddin'-me" moment because they looked so small at first glance. BUT DON'T BE FOOLED, Stick one foot in and you'll understand. The fabric melts like butter around your legs, over your rump and securely hugging your tummy in a way that not only makes you look good, but actually feel good, which makes you look even better. No squeezing, no bunching, no riding, no tearing, no slouching, no anything less than perfect. They are absolutely beyond worth the price, I'm super cheap and was really going out on a limb when buying these but now I sincerely wish I had more legs so I can wear more than one pair at a time. Seriously, I'd be unstoppable
